verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only Firecrawl acting as an MCP server, which lets other AI tools connect to Firecrawl (firecrawl-docs-5, firecrawl-probe-3). That is the opposite role and earns no credit for this story. Because Firecrawl ships its own AI agent, consuming external MCP servers is a fair axis, but nothing shows Firecrawl or its agent can connect to third-party MCP servers and use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
